keep_vs_drop_kappa_note: undefined: no double-reviewed lines, or both reviewers made the same keep/drop choice on every line

definitions.double_reviewed_lines: lines with a decision from two non-adjudication reviewers; lines with one or no decision are counted separately, never as agreement
definitions.agreement_rate: both keep the line with identical normalised text, or both drop it
definitions.keep_vs_drop_kappa: Cohen's kappa on the two reviewers' keep (gold_ok/utrnet_ok/corrected) vs drop (exclude/illegible) decisions
definitions.inter_reviewer_cer_pct: total edit distance / total max(len) between the two reviewers' normalised texts, on lines both kept
